models_billing_hint_threshold: Threshold: N tokens cost 1 computing power point (higher = cheaper). 1 point = ¥0.04.
models_billing_hint_price_source: Input/output/cache cost (CNY per 1M) shown in the list is auto-converted by system code: CNY/1M = 0.04×10⁶ ÷ threshold — not computed live by the LLM. After manual edit or AI plan apply, thresholds are stored and displayed via the same formula.
models_billing_hint_range: raw_token_threshold: this tier applies when input tokens ≤ the upper bound; empty means unlimited fallback tier.
models_billing_hint_warn: If all tiers are deleted, billing returns 0 power. Keep at least one tier.
models_billing_hint_reset: “Restore defaults” rewrites tiers from the code catalog (delete existing, then recreate). Only models/vendors registered in default_vendor_model_billing are supported.
models_billing_reset_confirm: Restore billing tiers for “{{model}}” to code defaults? Existing tiers will be deleted and recreated. This cannot be undone.
models_billing_reset_vendor_confirm: Restore “{{model}} / {{vendor}}” to code defaults? Existing tiers under this vendor will be deleted and recreated.
models_billing_reset_no_defaults: No code defaults registered for this model
models_billing_empty: No vendor billing tiers for this model yet.
models_billing_period_hint: Standard = no peak/off-peak; Peak/Off-peak are billed by call time (Beijing time 9:00-12:00, 14:00-18:00 = peak, else off-peak). You can configure separate peak and off-peak tiers for the same range. Tip: keep one mode per vendor-model (all standard OR all peak/off-peak); mixing makes standard tiers ineffective.
models_billing_yuan_hint: Enter vendor cost (CNY per 1M tokens). Threshold is auto-computed by system code; display is reverse-converted from threshold, not live LLM math.
models_billing_commission_hint: Markup 0–100%. User price = cost × (1+rate). Billing multiplies power by (1+rate).
models_billing_unlimited_hint: Recommended: keep one unlimited tier per vendor for large contexts.
models_billing_raw_hint: Use this tier when raw_input_token ≤ this value, e.g. 128000 for ≤128K.
models_billing_threshold_hint: How many tokens cost 1 computing power point (positive integer).
models_billing_ai_global_desc: The model selected below is only used for “Generate with AI”: it turns your natural-language instructions into tier price/markup proposals. Displayed input/output costs are always converted by system code from thresholds, not computed live by the LLM.
models_billing_ai_llm_hint: Format: vendor / model. Default deepseek / deepseek-v4-pro. Same model under multiple vendors appears as separate options.
toast_billing_ai_need_llm: Please select a responsible model (vendor + model)
models_billing_ai_placeholder_normal: e.g. Official price: input 1 CNY/1M, output 2, cache 0.1, markup 20% (standard, one price set)
models_billing_ai_placeholder_peak: e.g. (peak/off-peak, must give BOTH price sets): peak input 3/output 9/cache 0.1, off-peak input 1.5/output 4.5/cache 0.05
models_billing_ai_confirm_hint: Columns show user charge vs vendor cost (CNY per 1M tokens). Nothing is saved until you confirm.
toast_invalid_raw_threshold: Please enter a valid upper bound
confirm_delete_billing_tier: Delete billing tier for range 「{{range}}」? Takes effect immediately.

rh_pool_locked_desc: RunningHub multi-key rotation and circuit-breaker probing is an enterprise feature. It allows configuring up to 10 keys for concurrency scaling and automatic failover. Please purchase the enterprise edition to enable.
rh_pool_desc: Configure multiple RunningHub API keys for rotation and concurrency scaling. The system auto-selects by least-load-first; a key that fails consecutively is circuit-broken and probed after cooldown. Falls back to global api_key when the pool is empty.
rh_pool_empty: No keys configured. Click edit to add one.
rh_pool_no_global_key: ⚠️ Global api_key (runninghub.api_key) not configured. No fallback when pool is empty.
rh_api_key_hint: Leave blank when editing to keep the current value
rh_confirm_delete: Delete this key slot? Associated runtime data will be cleared.

branding_terms_desc: Content shown when users click Terms of Service during registration/login. Supports txt/md, file ≤ 2MB
branding_wx_group_qr_desc: Replace the QR code shown in the official WeChat group guide (bottom-right). Falls back to system default if not set.
branding_reset_confirm: Reset to default? All customized site name, Logo, Favicon and user manuals will be restored to defaults, and uploaded files will be deleted.
um_description: Describe a third-party image, video, or audio API. The agent inspects the public contract and generates integration code in an isolated draft.
um_safety_desc: The agent may only read the public contract, write staging files, and validate them. Approval, enablement, disabling, and rollback always require an explicit administrator action.
um_modules_desc: New requests use the currently enabled implementation; in-flight asynchronous jobs remain pinned to their original implementation.
um_search_placeholder: Search module ID, name, or status
um_no_modules: No API modules have been published
um_drafts_desc: Review agent output and validation reports, then decide whether to approve publication.
um_create_title: Guide the Agent to Generate API Code
um_create_desc: Provide the vendor API, authentication, synchronous or asynchronous flow, and expected inputs and outputs in as much detail as possible.
um_module_id_hint: A stable lowercase namespace containing at least one dot, underscore, or hyphen. Avoid changing it after publication.
um_comfyui_base_url_hint: The ComfyUI instance this module should call. The server process must be able to reach it. Each module can point at a different machine.
um_comfyui_workflow_hint: Choose the JSON exported from ComfyUI via Save (API Format).
um_requirement_placeholder: Example: Integrate the Acme image API. POST /v1/images creates a job using a Bearer token from ACME_API_KEY; it returns task_id. Poll GET /v1/images/{task_id} every 2 seconds until an image URL is returned...
um_requirement_hint: Include request/response JSON, error codes, callback or polling rules, and official documentation links.
um_requirement_comfyui_hint: The workflow JSON and ComfyUI URL are already attached. Add only extra notes, such as “Qwen Image Edit, image-to-image”.
um_generation_ack: I understand generated code is never published automatically. I will inspect hosts, secret names, capabilities, source code, and validation results before approval.
um_agent_progress_hint: The agent queries public protocols, writes to isolated staging, and validates repeatedly. HTTP vendors may ask up to 15 questions; local ComfyUI may ask up to 15 (node mapping). Answer in the card promptly.
um_agent_waiting: Waiting for the first progress event…
um_background_notice: The agent task will continue in the background. If a question is pending, the progress window will reopen.
um_select_file: Select a file on the left
um_not_validated: Validation has not run. Only a passing draft can be approved.
um_review_error: Auto review failed, please re-validate or check manually
um_approval_warning_title: Approval performs a real Runner health check
um_approval_warning_desc: Approval publishes an immutable implementation but does not enable it. Enable it separately from the version list.
um_secret_grant_note: Approving this release grants the module runtime access to the secrets above (values are injected only into the module process, never shown in code, logs, or this page).
um_secret_not_in_catalog: Not in the grantable catalog; static validation will reject it
um_no_bindings: Not bound to any model entry yet
um_binding_delete_confirm: Unbind the {operation} capability? Related model entries will no longer offer this implementation.
um_binding_multi_hint: Bind each capability separately. Text-to-image and image edit can both be active. If a model entry belongs to both categories, bind it once per capability. After binding, the channel appears in that model's implementation group and in the user-facing channel list.
um_binding_created: Binding created; the model entry now offers this implementation
um_bindings_need_active: Activate the module before binding model entries
um_approve_confirm: Have you reviewed the code, network hosts, secret declarations, and validation report, and do you want to publish this implementation? It will not be enabled automatically.
um_enable_confirm: Enable version {{version}}? New requests will start using this implementation.
um_rollback_confirm: Switch new requests to version {{version}}? In-flight asynchronous jobs will remain on their original implementation.
um_disable_confirm: Disable module {{module}}? New requests will be rejected, but in-flight asynchronous jobs will not be forcibly interrupted.
um_approve_success: Implementation approved and published; choose whether to enable it
um_start_failed: Failed to start the generation agent
um_missing_task_id: The server did not return a task ID
um_activate_failed: Failed to enable or switch implementation
um_agent_question_free_text_placeholder: Optional: extra notes or paste API documentation
um_agent_question_need_choice: Choose an option or enter free text
um_agent_pending_banner: The agent is waiting for your answer. Click to review.
um_agent_tasks_desc: Reopen the dialog from here after closing to review the agent's full output
um_enable_module_confirm: Re-enable module {module}? Its current release will be restored and new requests will use it.
um_delete_confirm: Delete module {module}? It will be hidden from the list; historical task records are kept.
um_delete_need_disabled: Module is still enabled; disable it before deleting
um_code_empty: No files to display for this release
um_binding_inactive_hint: Module is not activated yet: click "Enable This Version" in the version list above, then bind model entries here.
um_locked_desc: AI-generated user API modules (generation, review, publishing and task binding) are part of the commercial edition. Upgrade to connect new image/video providers here.
models_local_inference_desc: Enable and address Ollama / vLLM local models. Takes effect immediately after saving (llm.ollama / llm.vllm).
models_local_inference_save_failed: Failed to save local inference config
models_local_inference_hint: Ensure the service is running locally before enabling; sampling params (temperature, etc.) live in System Config.
